snippet.title: “Taste of the Wind” – Steam Next Fest PV
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m the solo developer of Taste of the Wind.
This is the brand-new PV I made for Steam Next Fest—where the story begins again.

You once helped your family’s restaurant as a child…
until one day, everything collapsed, and a childhood friend returned—with a $1 million debt. 💸

Manage your restaurant, rebuild your life, learn secret skills, and uncover the truth hidden in Stone Town.
Every choice you make will lead to a different ending.

✨ Features
・Restaurant management × Story adventure × Life simulation
・Multiple endings & character routes
・Hand-drawn CGs and original soundtrack
・Developed solo from start to now!

🎮 Play the demo now during Steam Next Fest and add it to your wishlist!
